axes.model_access:
**The Pro tier lists providers explicitly**: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, **SpaceXAI**
and leading open-source models.

**The in-house model SWE-2 is officially labeled "Free use of SWE-2"**,
and the pricing page header additionally states **"SWE-2, our latest model, is now available"**.

**The Free tier is labeled "Limited model availability".**
axes.runtime:
**Important change: Windsurf has been renamed Devin Desktop** —

the official docs title the stable-release notes "agent-native editor";
the download page offers macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel),
Windows (arm64 / x64) and Linux x64 for Debian.

**Folder selection on SSH or WSL hosts is supported**.
axes.local_files:
A local editor that reads and writes the workspace directly. **Official context-awareness page wording**:
"The entire local codebase is then indexed (including files that are
not open)" — **the whole local codebase is indexed by the RAG context engine**, with snippets fetched on demand at retrieval time.

The Pro tier has larger index caps and context length; **Teams / Enterprise can index remote repositories**.

Files in `.gitignore` are not exposed to Cascade by default (Cascade Gitignore Access is off by default); `.codeiumignore` can exclude paths.

**Fast Context is a dedicated retrieval subagent**
(SWE-grep / SWE-grep-mini models, using only grep / read / glob,
up to 4 rounds, at most 8 parallel tool calls per round). You can also drag files into the panel or send a selection to chat.
axes.background:
**True background comes from Devin Cloud**: official `windsurf/devin` page wording
"Each Devin session runs on its own VM with a desktop, browser,
and computer use, so it can keep working after you close your laptop" —

each Devin session runs on its own cloud VM, **keeping working after you close the laptop**.
You can plan locally with Cascade and hand it to Devin cloud for implementation in one click,
with sessions appearing in the Agent Command Center.

Local Cascade and Devin Local
run on your machine (Devin Local **"operates on your machine"**) and need the client resident.

Note Devin Cloud access is rolling out, and Enterprise requires an admin to enable it.
axes.tools:
**Supports the Agent Client Protocol (ACP)** —
the docs site has **"Agent Client Protocol (preview)"** and
**"Building a custom ACP agent"** as dedicated pages, indicating ACP is in preview.

**MCP support has one important detail**:

the changelog records that MCP servers passed in by ACP clients
can now be used and listed by the agent,
**including HTTP and SSE type MCP servers**.
axes.context:
**The Memories mechanism is verified** (official `cascade/memories` page): Cascade
automatically generates and stores memories during conversations, and you can ask it to "create a memory";

memories bind to the workspace, stored locally at `~/.codeium/windsurf/memories/`,
not committed to the repo, **consuming no credits**, auto-retrieved when Cascade deems them relevant.

For cross-session persistence the official recommendation is Rules (global / workspace / system three levels,
`.windsurf/rules/*.md`) or `AGENTS.md`. **There is also session history**:

the changelog records that switching back to one of the 10 most recently viewed sessions shows its transcript immediately.

The underlying context engine is RAG (official M-Query retrieval).
axes.permissions:
**There are explicit security mechanisms and CVE fix records**:
the changelog records a fix for a Restricted Mode bypass
(CVE-2026-81376) —
previously only dotted-form restricted workspace settings were checked,
now nested-object form is checked too.

**This one is worth noting: Restricted Mode could once be bypassed via nested objects.**

sections.最重要的一件事：产品已改名:
**The release-notes title on the official docs site is now "Devin Desktop"**,
described as an "agent-native editor".

This means:

- you may not find Windsurf's latest docs by searching the old name
- brand, version numbers and pricing structure all follow Cognition
- **Cognition runs two product lines at once: Devin (cloud) and Devin Desktop (the editor)**

**This item has confirmatory significance for this site's methodology**:
[Methodology rule 3 "don't mix layers"](../../../METHODOLOGY.md) is exactly about this kind of problem —
a renamed product kept under its old name would directly mislead.
sections.档位结构：两层计费要特别注意:
(Quote numbers are not stored per the D9 rule; see the official pricing page.)

| Tier | Key contents |
|---|---|
| **Free** | Light quota, **limited model availability**, **unlimited inline edits**, **unlimited Tab completion** |
| **Pro** | Higher quota covering **OpenAI / Claude / Gemini / SpaceXAI** frontier models + leading open-source models, full model availability, **free use of SWE-2**, **an officially labeled limited-time free period for Devin Desktop and CLI (until 2026-10-10)**, Devin Cloud access, **add-on usage billed at API prices** |
| **Teams** | **Two-layer billing: a plan monthly fee + per-full-time-developer seats**, up to 200 users, collaboration and centralized billing |

**Three easy pitfalls**:

| Misconception | Reality |
|---|---|
| Teams bills by seats only | **two layers**: plan monthly fee + seat fee |
| Add-on usage gets a discount | **billed at API prices**, i.e. no discount |
| The free period is long-term | **ends 2026-10-10** (Devin Desktop and CLI) |
sections.模型供应：多供应商 + 自研模型:
**The Pro tier lists four providers explicitly**:
OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, **SpaceXAI** (xAI).

**The in-house model SWE-2**:

- the pricing page header states "SWE-2, our latest model, is now available"
- the Pro tier states "Free use of SWE-2"

**The Free tier is "Limited model availability"** —
this is the core Free-vs-Pro difference, more notable than quota.
sections.ACP 支持（preview 阶段）:
The docs site has two ACP dedicated pages:

- **Agent Client Protocol (preview)**
- **Building a custom ACP agent**

**This shows ACP is in preview, not a stable feature.**

**But the changelog has one notable advance**:

```
MCP servers passed by an ACP client ... are now usable by the agent
and listed in ..., including for HTTP and SSE MCP servers
```

**MCP servers passed in via ACP clients are now usable,
including HTTP and SSE types.**

This is stronger than what the official reference servers can do —
in this repository's tools section, most official servers only support stdio.
sections.安全：有过 Restricted Mode 的 CVE:
The changelog records one fix:

```
Restricted Mode blocks restricted workspace settings written in
nested object form, not just the dotted form (CVE-2026-81376).
```

**What it means**: Restricted Mode used to block only restricted workspace settings written in dotted form (`a.b.c`);
now it also blocks nested-object form.

**This deserves a standalone record**, because it reveals a real permission bypass:
**Restricted Mode could once be bypassed via nested-object form.**

For an AI coding tool, Restricted Mode is an important security boundary,
and the existence of such a fix reminds us: this boundary was once more fragile than it looked.
sections.平台支持:

|---|---|

**And folder selection on SSH or WSL hosts is supported** —
meaning it can operate on directories on remote hosts.
